'''Gold Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|callsign]] used by a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served as leader of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during a strike on a [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]] facility.<ref name="SW:RS" />
